docstring:
Let $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ be an infinite set. Must there be a set $E \subseteq \mathbb{R}$
of positive measure which does not contain any set of the shape $a * A + b$
for some $a,b \in \mathbb{R}$ and $a \neq 0$?
references: [St20](http://matwbn.icm.edu.pl/ksiazki/fm/fm1/fm1111.pdf) Steinhaus, Hugo, Sur les distances des points dans les ensembles de measure positive. Fund. Math. (1920), 93-104.
type_pretty: True ↔ ∀ (A : Set ℝ), A.Infinite → Erdos120.Erdos120For A
